transcript: Throw a garlic clove down the toilet if you want to put an end to your financial bad streak, bad luck and bad energy. If you feel like money slips through your fingers, nothing you do moves forward and something is blocking your path. Do this. Grab a garlic clove, the one that catches your attention the most. Hold it in your hand and pass it all over your body, making circular movements from your head to your feet. Do it with as little clothing as possible so the garlic absorbs everything without barriers. Garlic is one of the most powerful energetic absorbers that exists. For centuries it has been used to cleanse, protect and cut away what does not belong to you while you pass it over your body, say silently. With this garlic I release every bad streak, every stagnation and every envy that is keeping me from moving forward, what blocks me leaves, my paths open up, then throw it down the toilet and flush. The water carries everything away. Do it with intention, not in a rush and do not tell anyone while you are doing it. What you protect in silence works with greater force. Many people notice that after doing it things start to move. Money that was stuck shows up. Opportunities that seemed closed open up. That feeling of being blocked dissolves. Write in the comments done if you are going to do it today. But I want you to understand something. Garlic cleanses what comes from outside. But if inside you fear of money is still living, anxiety about the future and a scarcity mindset you have been carrying for years, abundance has nowhere to stay. Money does not flow toward fear, it flows toward calm. Rituals open doors. But what keeps them open is what happens inside you. And if you want to release the fear that is blocking your prosperity and live from a place of calm where everything flows. I have spent over 20 years quietly learning how to do it. And everything I know is inside the way back to calm. The link is in my profile.
